title: Pilots mistaking U-2 and SR-71 for UFOs

tellings.quote: at UFOs that are streaking above them at like three or four times their speed, two or three times the height that they're at at 35,000 ft. Okay, they were seeing the U2 spy plane or the SR71 Blackbird, but they didn't know about that because that was secret.

plain: Pilots in the 1950s and 60s who reported UFOs streaking above them, at three or four times their speed and two or three times their height of 35,000 feet, were really seeing America's secret spy planes, the U-2 and the SR-71 Blackbird. That is the explanation the skeptic Michael Shermer gives Michels, without naming a source. The pilots couldn't have known what they saw, he says, because the planes were secret, and if he is right, many of that era's sightings were secret aircraft and not anything unexplained.
